prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. A single cohesive editorial graphic for a university course renewal slide. One presentation screen placed upright behind an open book; the book overlaps the lower right of the screen to visually unite learning slides and bibliography in one graphic. Screen contains two gray lines and a small lime bar chart. Book has a small lime ribbon. Minimal flat 2D vector-like outline illustration, refined thin muted indigo #4f46e5 strokes, white pages, solid pale indigo secondary fills, small lime #84cc16 accents. Compact balanced composition, all objects grouped as one coherent central subject. Transparent background with clean alpha cutout, every pixel outside the objects fully transparent. No shadow, no glow, no halos, no bloom, no background light, no gradients, no texture, no 3D, no people, no text, no labels, no cards or containers, no frames around the whole illustration. It will sit freely on a gray #f3f4f6 slide surface. Landscape 4:3 graphic, generous empty transparent space around the subject.
